Mr. I. C. Herried Chief Development Engineer Wisconsin Division of Highways Facilities Development Section Room 551 4802 Sheboygan Avenue Madison, Wisconsin 53702
ee: HHB HLF. EJB DE 9 JCH HKB File
Subject: Draft Environmental Statement Airport Spur
I-94 to General Mitchell Field
Dear Mr. Herried:
We have reviewed the subject environmental impact statement submitted to us with your letter of June 19, 1973. In addition, we have reviewed a number of the bibliographical reference materials outlined therein. My staff has verified most of the calculations and results reported in the subject document relating to automotive air pollutant emissions within the limitations of the available data.
Accordingly, we find the impact statement a correct portrayal of the air pollution considerations attendant to the subject project.
Yours sincerely,
DEPARTMENT OF AIR POLLUTION CONTROL
Fred R. Rehm Director
